item.title: Hispanic voters helped bring Trump to power - in Texas, the tide may be turning
item.description: Recent polls suggest the president is facing challenging headwinds in the state ahead of the midterms.

item.title: Are California voters about to impose 'world's first' tax on billionaires?
item.description: Voters are about to decide if the mega-rich among them should hand over billions of dollars to pay for improvements to healthcare.

item.title: Ruins of Limoges city hall a symbol of France divided by national protests
item.description: Younger Limoges residents see the destruction of their town hall as unfortunate collateral damage in a wider movement. For others, the fire was an unacceptable tragedy.

item.title: How Brazil's changing working class is reshaping the presidential race

item.title: Damaging hail pelts Phoenix in rare storm

item.description: The BBC's Madeline Halpert spoke to city tourists, residents and horse carriage workers about the industry and their opinion on the ban.

item.title: Blue Planet III: Moment octopus escapes death after hunt gone wrong
item.description: The sequence is part of the latest Blue Planet series from Sir David Attenborough.

item.title: Doctors tell the BBC about the targeting of Sudanese hospitals by paramilitary fighters
item.description: A BBC investigation has found evidence that Sudanese paramilitary fighters systematically destroyed el-Fasher's healthcare system.

item.title: Who actually controls Ukraine's access to Starlink?

item.description: The soldiers were killed in an attack by two Palestinian gunmen at a checkpoint outside the West Bank city on Friday morning.

item.description: Thirty-four people are also injured in the attack in southern Karak governorate, and a manhunt is now under way.

item.title: Trump administration sues to block certification of upcoming Alaska election

item.title: Seven missing after multi-storey building collapses in Kenya's capital
item.description: Rescue efforts are under way to find people trapped under the block, which was still under construction when it buckled.

item.title: Australian MP's condition improves after alleged car attack

item.description: From 30 October, tariffs will be eased on some products, including certain machinery, and placed on others, such as carpets.

item.title: Student movement takes Serbia's Vučić to the wire in neck-and-neck election

item.description: Kaylub Giamanco has been hailed as a hero for killing a teenager who fatally shot three children and a teacher.
